summary: When the page loads, we set up a listener that watches for slide changes in a presentation. Whenever a slide changes, we search through that slide's HTML content for text wrapped in double equal signs (like ==highlighted text==) and replace it with the same text wrapped in HTML mark tags so CSS can style it visually.

explanations.7: This creates a regular expression pattern that matches text between two pairs of equal signs. The [^=]* part means 'any characters except equals signs', and the parentheses capture just the text inside so we can reuse it later.
explanations.8: We're replacing all instances of the pattern in the slide's HTML using a global RegExp. The $1 in the replacement string refers back to the captured text from the parentheses in our pattern, so we keep the text but wrap it in mark tags instead of equal signs.
